findings.summary: Directory-mode mutual exclusion uses repositoryRef although distinct refs may resolve to the same physical directory.
findings.evidence: Lock row and active task SQL are keyed by repositoryRef; Workspace rootPath is not unique, and LOCAL_LINK permits aliases. Two refs to one directory use separate locks and may both be active.
findings.requested_change: Reject overlapping targets or serialize by canonical physical directory identity, including local links, duplicate roots and path aliases.
